name: Boot & Application Entry
description: MicroPython firmware boot entry point and the top-level App controller that wires all subsystems together and drives the async event loop on the Pico W.

name: Application Services
description: Core runtime services managing WiFi connectivity, NTP time synchronisation, OpenWeatherMap data fetching, async event scheduling, HTTP configuration UI, mDNS advertisement, and persistent JSON config storage.

name: Hardware Driver
description: Low-level Waveshare 3.7" ePaper SPI/GPIO driver providing 1-bit and 4-gray display modes, partial refresh, LUT loading, and power management directly against the RP2040 hardware.

name: Display Layer
description: ePaper framebuffer abstraction and all screen renderers — including the main composite screen, calendar grid, AP-mode setup guide, and status message screen — built on top of the LandscapeCanvas.

name: Font Renderer
description: Writer and CWriter core font-rendering library with GUI widget primitives and hardware setup helpers for drawing proportional and monospaced bitmap fonts onto MicroPython framebuffer-compatible displays.

name: Font Data & Writer Dev Assets
description: Static bitmapped font data modules (clock, Courier, FreeSans, Noto, and compact fonts), the Writer test suite, and legacy writer implementations kept for historical reference.

name: mDNS Library
description: Vendored third-party mDNS client library providing async UDP packet dispatch, DNS wire-format parsing and serialisation, service advertisement, and TTL-based service discovery for Pico W network presence.

name: Project Configuration
description: Development environment configuration files including VS Code workspace settings, MicroPico extension marker, git ignore rules, and the static Taiwan city coordinate dataset used by the weather location selector.
